title: 第一卷 第23章 黑袍大宗师
content_zh:
秦绝看着倒地昏迷的黄刚，也是一愣。

    这家伙嚣张的时候很嚣张，怂的时候也是真怂。

    “秦小友，让你见笑了，老朽就先领他回去了，日后有空，再来登门叨扰。”黄秋云无奈的拱了拱手。

    要不是他儿子和儿媳早些年都没了，现在他就只剩这么一个孙子了，他真是恨不得将黄刚这丢人的玩意，丢到大河里去。

    秦绝抱拳回礼，轻笑道：“好，黄老请便。”

    黄秋云弯下腰，一把抓住黄刚背后的衣衫，将人提走了。

    司马祥轻笑道：“秦少爷，这位就是齐钊，你有什么想问的，问他便好，老朽也还有点事，就先告辞了。”

    秦绝眼眸一闪，抱拳道：“好，司马先生慢走。”

    司马祥呵笑一声，转身离去。

    齐钊这才上前作礼道：“齐钊见过秦少爷。”

    刚才两位大人物在，他自然是插不上话的。

    “齐队长不必多礼，我们去那边坐下谈。”秦绝邀着齐钊，走向不远处的一张石桌。

    “小荷，取两碗茶饮过来。”

    “奴婢这就去。”

    落座后，秦绝眼眸微沉道：“齐队长，想必你也知道我想问什么，那一夜究竟是什么情况，齐队长知道多少，就请告诉我多少。若消息有用，我秦绝绝不会亏待了齐队长。”

    齐钊忙道：“秦少爷，其实我知道的也不多，但我知道的，都会说出来。”

    随即，齐钊眼皮上翻了些许，一边回忆，一边讲述起那一夜他所遇到的一切。

    “那一夜，我带着兄弟们在城中巡逻，忽然听到剧烈的震空之响，紧接着便隐约瞧见秦府上空，有数道黑影交闪碰撞，震空之声，愈发急猛，便知是秦府遭了夜袭。

    虽然那般战斗，不是我们这个层面的武者能够参与的，但身为城中守军，我们也只能硬着头皮过去查看。但没想到，在前去的路上，就被一名黑袍人拦住了去路。

    这人身高七尺，体态高壮，双目威凛，冷光含煞，绝非是一般武者，应该是一个久处高位之人。他看见我们后，什么也没说，抬手就是一掌，将我们所有人都震晕了过去。他应该是没想杀我们，否则的话，以他的实力，我们根本就活不下来。

    后来，我们醒了，黑袍人早已不见了，秦府里也不再有震空声响传出，我知道战斗已经结束了，但还是跑去秦府看了一眼……”
content_en:
Qin Jue was also stunned when he looked at Huang Gang who fell to the ground unconscious.

    This guy is very arrogant when he is arrogant, and he is really cowardly when he is cowardly.

    "Little friend Qin, if I make you laugh, I will take him back first. I will visit him again when I have time in the future." Huang Qiuyun reluctantly handed over his hand.

    If his son and daughter-in-law hadn't died a few years ago, and now he only had one grandson left, he would really like to throw Huang Gang, this shameful thing, into the river.

    Qin Jue clasped his fists in return and said with a chuckle, "Okay, please, Mr. Huang."

    Huang Qiuyun bent down, grabbed Huang Gang's clothes from behind, and lifted him away.

    Sima Xiang chuckled and said: "Master Qin, this is Qi Zhao. If you have anything to ask, just ask him. I still have something to do, so I will leave first."

    Qin Jue's eyes flashed, he cupped his fists and said, "Okay, Mr. Sima, walk slowly."

    Sima Xiang laughed, turned and left.

    Qi Zhao then stepped forward to salute and said, "Qi Zhao has met Young Master Qin."

    With the two big shots here just now, he naturally couldn't get a word in.

    "Captain Qi, there's no need to be polite. Let's sit down and talk over there." Qin Jue invited Qi Zhao and walked towards a stone table not far away.

    "Xiao He, bring over two bowls of tea."

    "Slave, go now."

    After sitting down, Qin Jue's eyes sank slightly and he said: "Captain Qi, I believe you also know what I want to ask. What happened that night? Please tell me as much as Captain Qi knows. If the information is useful, I, Qin Jue, will never treat Captain Qi badly."

    Qi Zhao hurriedly said: "Master Qin, actually I don't know much, but what I know, I will tell you."

    Immediately, Qi Zhao rolled his eyelids a little, recalling and recounting everything he encountered that night.

    "That night, I was patrolling the city with my brothers when I suddenly heard a violent sound that shook the sky. Then I vaguely saw several black shadows flashing and colliding in the sky above Qin Mansion. The sound of shaking the sky became more and more fierce, and I knew that Qin Mansion had been attacked at night.

    Although such a battle is not something that warriors at our level can participate in, but as the defenders of the city, we can only bite the bullet and go over to check. But unexpectedly, on the way forward, he was blocked by a man in black robes.

    This man was seven feet tall, with a tall and strong build, majestic eyes, and a cold light. He was by no means an ordinary warrior. He should be a person who had been in a high position for a long time. When he saw us, he didn't say anything. He raised his hand and slapped us, knocking us all unconscious. He probably didn't want to kill us, otherwise, with his strength, we wouldn't be able to survive at all.

    Later, when we woke up, the man in black robe had long disappeared, and there was no more loud noise in the Qin Mansion. I knew the battle was over, but I still ran to the Qin Mansion to take a look..."
title_en: Volume 1 Chapter 23 The Grand Master in Black Robe
